product_one_liner.value: Sauce Labs provides a cloud testing platform that helps software development and quality teams test web and mobile applications across browsers, operating systems, and real or virtual devices.
product_one_liner.notes: The company assurance report directly describes its cloud-hosted web and mobile testing platform, its software development and quality-team audience, and its real and virtual device infrastructure: https://assets.ctfassets.net/vrc8wif0t20g/YTclSunvGnFtxRuGi2E0r/4356091bb20bb1c94bf1ca3d07caf17f/Sauce_Labs_2023_SOC_3_Report-Final.pdf.

pricing_page.notes: The public pricing page lists plans and prices, including Live Testing: https://saucelabs.com/pricing.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Sauce Labs publishes customer case studies for Walmart and Aryaka Networks: https://saucelabs.com/resources/case-studies/walmart-embraces-test-automation-and-open-source-to-increase-coverage-and-deploy-more-often and https://saucelabs.com/resources/case-studies/aryaka-networks-accelerates-end-to-end-platform-coverage-using-autonomiq-sauce-labs. | named_customers.0: The customer case study says Walmart runs 50,000 tests a day on Sauce Labs: https://saucelabs.com/resources/case-studies/walmart-embraces-test-automation-and-open-source-to-increase-coverage-and-deploy-more-often. | named_customers.1: Aryaka Networks is named in a Sauce Labs customer case study: https://saucelabs.com/resources/case-studies/aryaka-networks-accelerates-end-to-end-platform-coverage-using-autonomiq-sauce-labs.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 331 employees, which falls within 201–500: https://linkedin.com/company/sauce-labs. Profile-derived headcounts may differ from payroll headcount.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company assurance report explicitly states that Sauce Labs is headquartered in San Francisco, California: https://assets.ctfassets.net/vrc8wif0t20g/YTclSunvGnFtxRuGi2E0r/4356091bb20bb1c94bf1ca3d07caf17f/Sauce_Labs_2023_SOC_3_Report-Final.pdf. | hq_country: The company's assurance report identifies its headquarters as San Francisco, California, and the company profile explicitly identifies the country as United States: https://assets.ctfassets.net/vrc8wif0t20g/YTclSunvGnFtxRuGi2E0r/4356091bb20bb1c94bf1ca3d07caf17f/Sauce_Labs_2023_SOC_3_Report-Final.pdf and https://linkedin.com/company/sauce-labs.

founded_year.notes: The company profile explicitly reports a 2008 founding year: https://linkedin.com/company/sauce-labs.

eng_blog.notes: The open-source blog includes multiple substantive engineering posts. Diego Molina's post describes implementing browser-local search in Sauce Labs' Real Device Cloud, and his profile identifies him as a software engineer. Simon Stewart's Selenium Grid post explains architecture and first-person implementation decisions; his engineering contribution is evident from the article, although it does not state a formal job title. Sources: https://opensource.saucelabs.com/blog, https://opensource.saucelabs.com/blog/how_a_hackathon_improved_user_experience/, https://linkedin.com/in/diemol and https://opensource.saucelabs.com/blog/what_is_coming_in_selenium_4_the_new_selenium_grid/.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation index links several articles, including Test Authoring, Generate a test case, Test Authoring in your IDE and a Prompting guide: https://docs.saucelabs.com/sauce-ai/index.html.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current application page advertises an AI Architect role in Gurugram and describes building AI-powered continuous-testing features: http://job-boards.greenhouse.io/saucelabs/jobs/7096532.

model_provider.value: Google Cloud Platform — Gemini AI and Vertex API
model_provider.notes: The subprocessor disclosure explicitly names Google Cloud Platform, Gemini AI and Vertex API, and describes use in a customer-support chatbot, natural-language data queries and data analysis: https://trust.saucelabs.com/subprocessors. This establishes disclosed use, not exclusive use across every AI feature.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The security page names SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001:2022 and GDPR. Only the requested categories are included; GDPR is a compliance claim rather than a certification: https://www.saucelabs.com/security. | compliance_certs.0: SOC 2 Type II is explicitly named at https://www.saucelabs.com/security. | compliance_certs.1: ISO 27001:2022 is explicitly named at https://www.saucelabs.com/security. | compliance_certs.2: GDPR is explicitly included among the compliance claims at https://www.saucelabs.com/security.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: The latest publicly dated round identified is Series G: https://www.thecompanycheck.com/company/b/sauce-labs/ftv19l23bt5jlj5ny. However, https://pitchbook.com/profiles/company/55089-10 labels its latest deal Debt without a publicly visible date or amount. Series G therefore represents the latest dated round established, with a material source discrepancy. | funding_date: The latest publicly dated round identified is January 26, 2024, normalized to 2024-01: https://www.thecompanycheck.com/company/b/sauce-labs/ftv19l23bt5jlj5ny. An undated Debt label elsewhere prevents complete certainty that this is the absolute latest financing. | funding_amount_usd: The dated Series G record reports $79,873,528, corroborated at rounded precision as $79.87 million: https://tracxn.com/a/d/company/52ecc088e4b033a23dc72415/sauce%20labs#a:about and https://www.thecompanycheck.com/company/b/sauce-labs/ftv19l23bt5jlj5ny. This is the latest publicly dated round identified; an undated Debt label on another profile leaves uncertainty about absolute latest financing.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest publicly dated funding round identified occurred in January 2024, before the 18-month window beginning in May 2025: https://www.thecompanycheck.com/company/b/sauce-labs/ftv19l23bt5jlj5ny. This negative is qualified by the undated Debt label on PitchBook, which does not establish an in-window financing.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: A current application page lists an Account Executive opening in London: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/saucelabs/jobs/8267329.

launched_6mo.notes: On September 29, 2026, Sauce Labs announced ARM-native Android virtual devices in its Virtual Device Cloud, a substantive new testing capability within the six-month window: https://saucelabs.com/company/news/sauce-labs-launches-the-industrys-first-arm-native-android-testing-cloud-for-the-enterprise-at-scale.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The April 16, 2026 announcement names Steven Fitz as the new Chief Revenue Officer and Arun Lal as the new Senior Vice President of Global Marketing, within the 12-month window: https://www.accessnewswire.com/newsroom/en/computers-technology-and-internet/sauce-labs-assembles-%22new-sauce%22-leadership-team-to-dominate-1157999.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: The Inside Sales Representative posting explicitly requires pipeline management in Salesforce and experience using Salesforce and Outreach: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/saucelabs/jobs/8107367. | crm_stack_signal.0: The posting explicitly requires pipeline management within Salesforce: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/saucelabs/jobs/8107367. | crm_stack_signal.1: The posting explicitly names experience using Outreach: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/saucelabs/jobs/8107367.
